title: A Systematic Evaluation of Multi-modal Approaches to Complex Player Profile Classification
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable; the paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates model accuracy in classifying player profiles based on a fictional moral alignment system (e.g., Lawful Good, Chaotic Evil) from a role-playing game.
findings: This paper does not contain findings related to religion. Its focus is on classifying player profiles using a fictional moral alignment system from a role-playing game. The study finds that behavioral data alone is insufficient for complex classification, especially for 'neutral' profiles, suggesting a semantic gap that cannot be bridged without access to player reasoning, which is analogous to understanding intent beyond observed actions.
